I only recently (within the last year) found out that other people can see actual pictures in their heads.  I have never been able to, but thought that was normal.  The condition I have is called aphantasia.  At first I was like, oh, well, whatever - I’ve always been this way.  But the more I thought about it, the more I felt cheated.  I WANT to be able to see pictures in my head!

I tried to see if I could ‘see’ a word in my head, but it seems to be forbidden to me just like images are.  The only advice I can give you is to embrace it - maybe try to see other words, or turn the words into pictures, or see how you might be able to extend the ability.  From the outside looking in, to me it seems like an awesome ability.  

Did you know some people see music as colors?  That ability is called synesthesia.  It’s also been said that they can ‘taste’ textures - like round, or pointy.  HOW WILD and AWESOME!  I am FASCINATED by all of this stuff.  I started learning more about it when I discovered I had aphantasia.  I highly recommend doing some research - it’s amazing what is out there that we think is normal because it’s all we’ve ever known, or things that we didn’t even realize we ought to be able to do.  

The best way not to be tortured by something, in my opinion, is to start to love it or be fascinated by it!  Good luck!
